plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Paralegal/Law, AAS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/paralegal-law-aas/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Paralegal Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The grid includes two unnumbered 'Summer' sections: the first shows Semester Total 0 and is not sequenced; the second carries 6 units and is sequenced here as semester 5 in catalog order. The plan footnote numbered 4 in the schedule grid is not defined on this page — those slots are modeled as choice slots with an honest 'not defined on this page; see advisor' note; blank unnamed rows are likewise modeled as generic elective slots (see advisor). ABA-approved program (only one in Nevada); minimum 3.0 GPA in legal specialty coursework required; at least 9 credits of legal specialty courses must be completed live (in person or synchronous online). Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
